text:
marie: Quick note from partner kickoff call: before we push the Snowflake+Databricks+Qdrant connector bundle to the marketplace we need a short, customer-facing paragraph that explains hardware custody, staging inventory, and what telemetry we collect. Also need an internal runbook extract for on-call and FieldOps.

emma: For partners asking about staging: can we offer 2 levels? 
- Gold: partner cross-docks spares to our hubs (SFO/AMS/SIN), we handle swaps
- Silver: partner keeps spares, we coordinate RMA and remote assist
Which one do we want to surface in the listing?

ajay: From eng-side: Gold gives us 24h swap SLA in US/EU, 48h APAC. Silver -> remote triage + next-business-day RMA. Also, we need to list supported runtime images and the exact quantization profiles in the compatibility metadata.

ben: Ops: if Gold is chosen, we need an inventory manifest: serials, model, spare-location. Recommended spare counts per region: US 6, EU 4, APAC 3 for initial pilot. We can add NBD vs 24h air options as paid extras.

toni: Legal feedback: marketplace blurb must not promise uptime SLAs for customer-managed infra. We can state our response targets for swaps and RMA windows, but add a clause that final responsibility for data custody on private infra remains with customer/partner. I'll craft two short variants: one for partner agreements (detailed) and one for the public listing (concise).

sara: Product/marketplace asks: we need a single-line "what's included" and a short bullets section: supported DBs, recommended models, known limitations (max context, recommended batch), and telemetry summary. Example telemetry line: "We collect anonymized telemetry for stability and usage; no customer payload is stored." Toni, can you confirm that wording?

toni: That's close. Suggest: "We collect limited operational telemetry (errors, performance histograms, config hashes). Payload and query content are redacted and not retained." I'll add a pointer to our telemetry redaction doc. Also adding a partner custody sentence: "Partners must sign a staging custody addendum if hardware is hosted in our hubs."

ajay: Ops/runbook snippet we should include for oncall (short):
```
# connector quick recovery checklist
- confirm connector health: GET /internal/health -> 200
- check KV cache sizes and mem pressure -> /metrics
- restart connector container: ./scripts/restart-connector.sh --grace 30
- if ingestion fails > 10% -> escalate to eng oncall with logs + trace id
```

deploy-bot: preflight | connector-bundle -> 7/9 checks green. Databricks adapter integration test failing in CI. See <https://ci.redwood/boards/2345> for details. @ajay tagged.

emma: For listing UX, proposing icons for: "Gold-staged hardware", "Partner-hosted", "Private deploy-ready" and a short badge: "Supports live vector DBs: Qdrant, Milvus". Thoughts?

ben: UX ok. Also adding shipping notes: if partner wants APAC 24h, require pre-payment for air or partner pre-staging. Will send exact rates into the runbook.

marie: Action list (final): 1) @toni publish two telemetry/custody blurb variants by Tue EOD 2) @ben finalize spare counts & paid expedited shipping options by Tue noon 3) @ajay add runtime image list and runbook checklist into the partner runbook 4) @sara prepare marketplace bullets + icon list and lock listing window (tentative next Wed) 5) @emma coordinate partner choice (Gold vs Silver) and confirm pilot partner preference. Check-in Tuesday 11am PT. :spiral_calendar:

ajay: Will prioritize the CI failure, will update runbook after fix.

toni: Drafts coming Tue AM.

ben: Will confirm spares and rates by Tue.

emma: I'll poll the partner today and report back.

marie: Thanks all — want to run a dry-run swap after the first staging goes live.
